_doc: Hours calculator of the lift-and-shift track (from lift-and-shift-assessment 1.1.0; its rates are the source of truth), developer working hours assuming AI-assisted work. Each rate is [low, high] hours per unit. basis 'sample' = calibrated to the manager's reference estimate (72-108 h, source of truth); basis 'inferred' = the skill's own estimate with no sample behind it. Everything can be revised: nothing is final until the user says so. Lines are groups of work (one task per solution or per deployable), never per setting, per key or per address: the environment-specific configuration of a solution is one task whose hours depend on how much the solution holds (a straight-line curve on a weight = config files without publish profiles + secret-like settings + environment variables + distinct private IPs + 2 per third-party key). The curve is calibrated so the manager's sample (two solutions, 32-50 h of secrets, connection and re-key work) is reproduced.

activity_thresholds._doc: Commits per week over the git activity window that mark a repository active or hot (parallel-development risk in scan_repo.py).

lines.label: Environment-specific configuration per solution (config files, secrets and settings, addresses, third-party keys)
lines.anchors_doc: Weight -> [low, high] hours. Straight lines between neighbouring anchors, flat beyond the first and last one. The anchors are the centres of the old size bands, so the sample (two solutions, 32-50 h) is still reproduced.
